"""记录一次实验调用的源码、退出状态和原始输出，拒绝覆盖已有记录。"""

import argparse
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def digest(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--record", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--input", type=Path, action="append", default=[])
    parser.add_argument("command", nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    command = args.command[1:] if args.command[:1] == ["--"] else args.command
    if not command:
        parser.error("需要指定 Python 脚本及其参数")
    target = args.record.resolve()
    script = Path(command[0]).resolve()
    if not target.is_relative_to(ROOT) or target.exists() or not target.parent.is_dir():
        parser.error("记录须位于工作区已有目录，且不得覆盖")
    if not script.is_relative_to(ROOT) or not script.is_file():
        parser.error("脚本须为工作区内现有文件")
    inputs = dict.fromkeys([Path(__file__).resolve(), script, *(p.resolve() for p in args.input)])
    snapshots = {}
    for path in inputs:
        raw = path.read_bytes()
        snapshots[str(path)] = {"sha256": digest(raw), "source": raw.decode("utf-8")}
    invocation = [sys.executable, str(script), *command[1:]]
    started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
    begin = time.perf_counter()
    process = subprocess.run(invocation, cwd=ROOT, env=dict(os.environ, PYTHONUTF8="1"), capture_output=True)
    elapsed = time.perf_counter() - begin
    changed = [str(path) for path in inputs if not path.is_file() or digest(path.read_bytes()) != snapshots[str(path)]["sha256"]]
    record = {
        "started_at_utc": started,
        "completed_at_utc": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "command": invocation, "returncode": process.returncode, "elapsed_seconds": elapsed,
        "input_sources_before_execution": snapshots, "changed_inputs": changed,
        "stdout": process.stdout.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"),
        "stderr": process.stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"),
    }
    with target.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(record, stream, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        stream.write("\n")
    print(json.dumps({"record": str(target), "returncode": process.returncode,
                      "elapsed_seconds": elapsed, "changed_inputs": changed}, ensure_ascii=False))
    print(record["stdout"][-3500:])
    if record["stderr"]:
        print(record["stderr"][-3500:])
    return process.returncode or (1 if changed else 0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""复用冻结118评测运输层，只增加原生导出基和自主暖基阶段的严格账本。"""
import copy
import importlib.util
import math
from pathlib import Path
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
import build_experimental as B

PARENT_FILE = ROOT / ".tools/v118-benchmark.py"
PARENT_SHA = "4edf1c46c0acfd4f9c0725e074cbba757771448cdecc84c563bd5a7d9bd9aa99"
B.require(B.sha(PARENT_FILE) == PARENT_SHA, "冻结118运输层源码变化")
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("v120_frozen_v118_transport", PARENT_FILE)
P = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(P)
NATIVE_VALIDATOR, PARENT_SELF_CHECK = P.valid_crossover, P.self_check
NEW_VERSION = "ipm-ipx-crossover-cpu-0.3.0"
EXTRA_FIELDS = "crossover_status crossover_quality basis_export warm scope_seconds verification_seconds_total".split()
CALLS = "init factor solve_n solve_t ftran btran update".split()
COUNTS = "steps_started steps_completed pivots bound_flips zero_steps refactors rebuild_started rebuild_completed pricing_passes work_items verification_started verification_completed".split()
TIMES = "pricing_seconds rebuild_seconds verification_seconds total_seconds".split()
LAST_VALUES = "last_entering last_leaving last_theta last_pivot".split()
CHECK_NUMBERS = "equation_residual bound_violation basic_dual_residual equation_ratio bound_ratio basic_dual_ratio".split()
WARM_STATUSES = "accepted rejected invalid_input unsupported_empty singular_basis primal_infeasible numerical_error step_limit no_finite_step time_limit exception".split()
STAGES = "entry validation initialize factor rebuild solve_n solve_t pricing ftran ratio btran update verification projection cleanup finished".split()


def number(value, nonnegative=False, nullable=False):
    return P.number(value, nonnegative, nullable) and (value is None or abs(value) <= sys.float_info.max)


def contract(plan):
    value = plan["hybrid_protocol"]
    B.require(set(value) == {"validator_file", "validator_sha256", "environment", "marker", "schema",
        "on_backend_version", "off_backend_version", "marker_on_only"} and plan["candidate_version"] == 120 and
        plan["new_algorithm_round"] is True and plan["production_changes"] is False and
        plan["candidate_backend_version"] == value["on_backend_version"] == NEW_VERSION and
        value["off_backend_version"] == P.OLD_VERSION and value["environment"] == P.ENVIRONMENT and
        value["marker"] == P.MARKER and type(value["schema"]) is int and value["schema"] == 3 and
        value["marker_on_only"] is True, "混合120唯一版本/schema桥接不符")
    own = Path(__file__).resolve()
    B.require((ROOT / value["validator_file"]).resolve() == own and B.sha(own) == value["validator_sha256"], "120验证器身份变化")
    tools = {str((ROOT / name).resolve()): digest for name, digest in plan["tool_sources"].items()}
    B.require(tools.get(str(own)) == value["validator_sha256"] and tools.get(str(PARENT_FILE)) == PARENT_SHA,
        "计划必须显式锁定120及所复用的118运输层")
    B.verify(tools)
    return value


def close_time(left, right):
    return abs(left - right) <= 4 * math.ulp(max(left, right))


def checks(value):
    if value is None:
        return True
    if not P.fields(value, ["valid", "primal_feasible", "basis_dual_feasible"] + CHECK_NUMBERS) or \
        value["valid"] is not True or any(type(value[key]) is not bool for key in ("primal_feasible", "basis_dual_feasible")) or \
        not all(number(value[key], True, True) for key in CHECK_NUMBERS):
        return False
    return (not value["primal_feasible"] or all(value[key] is not None and value[key] <= 1 for key in ("equation_ratio", "bound_ratio"))) and \
        (not value["basis_dual_feasible"] or value["basic_dual_ratio"] is not None and value["basic_dual_ratio"] <= 1)


def quality_pair(raw, after, stats):
    started, completed = stats["verification_started"], stats["verification_completed"]
    if not 0 <= completed <= started <= 2 or started - completed > 1 or \
        any(value is not None and not P.quality(value) for value in (raw, after)) or \
        (raw is None) != (completed == 0) or (after is None) != (completed == 0) or \
        completed < 2 and not B.equal(raw, after):
        return False
    projection = stats["projection"]
    if started and not projection["enabled"] or projection["scan_started"] and (completed < 1 or P.complete_quality(raw)):
        return False
    if started == 2 and (projection["project_completed"] != 1 or projection["project_rc"] is not True or
        projection["changed_rows"] == 0 or P.complete_quality(raw)):
        return False
    return completed != 2 or projection["changed_rows"] == projection["eligible_rows"] and all(B.equal(raw[key], after[key]) for key in
        ("primal_valid", "primal_feasible", "objective_consistent", "objective", "max_row_violation", "max_bound_violation"))


def valid_warm(value):
    if not P.fields(value, "started completed max_steps status raw_quality after_quality stats".split()) or \
        not P.integer(value["started"], 1) or not P.integer(value["completed"], 1) or value["completed"] > value["started"] or \
        type(value["max_steps"]) is not int or value["max_steps"] != 64 or value["status"] not in WARM_STATUSES:
        return False
    stats = value["stats"]
    if not P.fields(stats, CALLS + COUNTS + TIMES + LAST_VALUES + ["initial_checks", "last_checks", "projection", "stage"]) or \
        not all(P.integer(stats[key]) for key in COUNTS) or not all(number(stats[key], True) for key in TIMES) or \
        stats["stage"] not in STAGES or not all(checks(stats[key]) for key in ("initial_checks", "last_checks")) or \
        not P.valid_projection(stats["projection"]):
        return False
    for name in CALLS:
        call = stats[name]
        if not P.fields(call, ["started", "completed", "rc", "seconds"]) or not all(P.integer(call[key]) for key in ("started", "completed")) or \
            not 0 <= call["started"] - call["completed"] <= 1 or not number(call["seconds"], True) or \
            (call["rc"] is None) != (call["completed"] == 0) or call["rc"] is not None and \
            (type(call["rc"]) is not int or not -(1 << 31) <= call["rc"] < (1 << 31)):
            return False
    if not all(stats[key] is None or P.integer(stats[key], (1 << 31) - 1) for key in ("last_entering", "last_leaving")) or \
        not number(stats["last_theta"], True, True) or not number(stats["last_pivot"], False, True):
        return False
    pivots = stats["pivots"] + stats["bound_flips"]
    if not 0 <= stats["steps_completed"] <= pivots <= stats["steps_started"] <= value["max_steps"] or \
        stats["steps_started"] - stats["steps_completed"] > 1 or stats["zero_steps"] > pivots or \
        not 0 <= stats["rebuild_started"] - stats["rebuild_completed"] <= 1 or stats["init"]["started"] > 1 or \
        stats["ftran"]["started"] > stats["steps_started"] or stats["btran"]["started"] > stats["ftran"]["completed"] or \
        stats["update"]["started"] > stats["btran"]["completed"] or stats["pivots"] > stats["update"]["completed"] or \
        not quality_pair(value["raw_quality"], value["after_quality"], stats):
        return False
    if value["completed"] == 0:
        return value["status"] in ("time_limit", "exception") and value["raw_quality"] is None and value["after_quality"] is None
    if value["status"] == "accepted":
        return all(stats[key]["started"] == stats[key]["completed"] and
            (stats[key]["completed"] == 0 or stats[key]["rc"] == 0) for key in CALLS) and \
            stats["steps_started"] == stats["steps_completed"] == pivots and \
            stats["rebuild_started"] == stats["rebuild_completed"] and \
            P.complete_quality(value["after_quality"]) and all(value["after_quality"][key] for key in P.QUALITY_BOOLS) and \
            stats["verification_started"] == stats["verification_completed"] >= 1 and all(stats[key]["completed"] >= 1 for key in
            ("init", "factor", "solve_n", "solve_t")) and all(stats[key] is not None and stats[key]["primal_feasible"] and
            stats[key]["basis_dual_feasible"] for key in ("initial_checks", "last_checks"))
    return True


def valid_crossover(value):
    if not P.fields(value, P.TOP_FIELDS) or type(value["schema"]) is not int or value["schema"] != 3 or \
        any(type(value[key]) is not bool for key in ("local_accepted", "adopted")) or \
        value["oracle_decision"] not in ("not_consulted", "not_active", "accept", "reject", "budget", "error"):
        return False
    event = value["last"]
    if event is not None and not P.fields(event, P.LAST_FIELDS + EXTRA_FIELDS):
        return False
    native = copy.deepcopy(value)
    native["schema"] = 2
    native["adopted"], native["oracle_decision"] = False, "not_consulted"
    if event is not None:
        native["last"] = {key: copy.deepcopy(event[key]) for key in P.LAST_FIELDS}
        native["last"].update(status=event["crossover_status"], after_quality=event["crossover_quality"])
        native["local_accepted"] = value["completed"] == 1 and event["crossover_status"] == "accepted"
    if not NATIVE_VALIDATOR(native):
        return False
    if event is None:
        return value["local_accepted"] is False and value["adopted"] is False and value["oracle_decision"] == "not_consulted"
    export, warm = event["basis_export"], event["warm"]
    if not P.fields(export, ["enabled", "statuses_requested", "statuses_received", "published", "columns", "rows"]) or \
        not all(type(export[key]) is bool for key in ("enabled", "statuses_requested", "statuses_received", "published")) or \
        not all(P.integer(export[key], (1 << 31) - 1) for key in ("columns", "rows")) or \
        any(not number(event[key], True) for key in ("scope_seconds", "verification_seconds_total")) or \
        event["status"] not in P.STATUSES or event["after_quality"] is not None and not P.quality(event["after_quality"]):
        return False
    if value["completed"] == 0:
        return event["status"] in ("exception", "time_limit") and warm is None and not any(export[key] for key in export) and event["after_quality"] is None and \
            value["local_accepted"] is False and value["adopted"] is False and value["oracle_decision"] == "not_consulted"
    stats = event["stats"]
    if any(not number(stats[key], True) for key in ("verification_seconds", "total_seconds")):
        return False
    if not export["enabled"] or export["statuses_requested"] != (stats["get_started"] == 1) or \
        export["statuses_received"] != (stats["get_completed"] == 1 and stats["get_rc"] == 0) or \
        export["published"] and (not export["statuses_received"] or event["crossover_status"] != "rejected"):
        return False
    if export["statuses_requested"] and (not export["columns"] or not export["rows"]):
        return False
    if warm is not None and (event["crossover_status"] != "rejected" or not export["published"] or not valid_warm(warm)):
        return False
    warm_accepted = warm is not None and warm["completed"] == 1 and warm["status"] == "accepted"
    selected_quality = warm["after_quality"] if warm_accepted else event["crossover_quality"]
    if not B.equal(event["after_quality"], selected_quality) or value["local_accepted"] is not (event["status"] == "accepted") or \
        event["status"] == "accepted" and not (event["crossover_status"] == "accepted" or warm_accepted) or \
        value["adopted"] and (not value["local_accepted"] or value["oracle_decision"] not in ("accept", "not_active")) or \
        value["oracle_decision"] != "not_consulted" and not value["local_accepted"]:
        return False
    verification = stats["verification_seconds"] + (warm["stats"]["verification_seconds"] if warm else 0)
    phases = stats["total_seconds"] + (warm["stats"]["total_seconds"] if warm else 0)
    return number(verification, True) and number(phases, True) and close_time(event["verification_seconds_total"], verification) and \
        phases <= event["scope_seconds"] + 4 * math.ulp(max(phases, event["scope_seconds"]))


def provenance(output, plan, create):
    for source, digest in ((Path(__file__).resolve(), plan["hybrid_protocol"]["validator_sha256"]), (PARENT_FILE, PARENT_SHA)):
        target = output / "provenance" / source.name
        if create and not target.exists():
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            with target.open("xb") as stream:
                stream.write(source.read_bytes())
        B.require(target.is_file() and B.sha(target) == digest, "混合120及冻结运输层快照缺失或变化")


def self_check(plan_path):
    previous = P.valid_crossover
    P.valid_crossover = NATIVE_VALIDATOR
    try:
        inherited = PARENT_SELF_CHECK(plan_path)
    finally:
        P.valid_crossover = previous
    # 新fixture只验证序列化和阶段事务，不执行任何数学内核或公开LP。
    good = dict.fromkeys(P.QUALITY_BOOLS, True)
    good.update(dict.fromkeys(P.QUALITY_NUMBERS, 0))
    before = dict(good, primal_feasible=False, gap_satisfied=False, numerically_optimal=False,
        max_row_violation=1e-5, objective_gap=1e-5, relative_objective_gap=1e-5)
    projection = dict.fromkeys(P.PROJECTION_COUNTS + ["max_abs_change", "seconds"], 0)
    projection.update(enabled=False, project_rc=None)
    prep = dict.fromkeys(P.PREP_COUNTS, 0)
    prep.update(max_aggregation_rounding=0, raw=dict.fromkeys(P.RESIDUAL_FIELDS, 0), dropped=dict.fromkeys(P.RESIDUAL_FIELDS, 0))
    native_stats = dict.fromkeys(P.STAT_COUNTS + P.STAT_TIMES + ["native_threads", "native_time_limit"], 0)
    native_stats.update(load_rc=None, crossover_rc=None, get_rc=None, preparation=prep, native_info=None, projection=projection)
    event = dict(iteration=1, bounds_inf=0, cost_inf=0, primal_ratio=1e-5, dual_ratio=0, relative_gap=1e-5,
        deadline_saturated=False, status="accepted", before_quality=before, unprojected_quality=good, after_quality=good,
        stats=copy.deepcopy(native_stats), crossover_status="accepted", crossover_quality=good,
        basis_export=dict(enabled=True, statuses_requested=True, statuses_received=True, published=False, columns=2, rows=1),
        warm=None, scope_seconds=0, verification_seconds_total=0)
    event["stats"].update(native_threads=1, native_time_limit=4, verification_started=1, verification_completed=1,
        native_info=dict.fromkeys(P.INFO_INTS + P.INFO_NUMBERS, 0))
    event["stats"]["native_info"].update(status_crossover=1, num_var=2, num_constr=1)
    event["stats"]["projection"]["enabled"] = True
    for role in ("load", "crossover", "get"):
        event["stats"].update({role + "_started": 1, role + "_completed": 1, role + "_rc": 0})
    native_success = dict(schema=3, enabled=True, attempted=True, started=1, completed=1, local_accepted=True, adopted=False,
        oracle_decision="not_consulted", norms_ready=True, norm_items=3, bounds_inf=0, cost_inf=0, gate_seconds=0,
        norm_seconds=0, gate_checks=1, last_gate_iteration=1, last_gate_measures=[1e-5, 0, 1e-5], last=event)
    rejected = copy.deepcopy(native_success)
    rejected["local_accepted"] = False
    bad_quality = dict(good, gap_satisfied=False, numerically_optimal=False, objective_gap=1e-4, relative_objective_gap=1e-4)
    rejected["last"].update(status="rejected", crossover_status="rejected", after_quality=bad_quality,
        crossover_quality=bad_quality, unprojected_quality=bad_quality)
    rejected["last"]["basis_export"]["published"] = True
    rejected["last"]["stats"]["projection"].update(scan_started=1, scan_completed=1, scan_items=1)
    warm_stats = dict.fromkeys(COUNTS + TIMES, 0)
    warm_stats.update({key: dict(started=0, completed=0, rc=None, seconds=0) for key in CALLS})
    warm_stats.update(dict.fromkeys(LAST_VALUES))
    warm_stats.update(initial_checks=None, last_checks=None, projection=copy.deepcopy(projection), stage="entry")
    wm = dict(started=0, completed=0, max_steps=64, status="time_limit", raw_quality=None, after_quality=None, stats=warm_stats)
    outer_entry = copy.deepcopy(rejected)
    outer_entry["last"].update(status="time_limit", warm=copy.deepcopy(wm))
    inner_budget = copy.deepcopy(outer_entry)
    inner_budget["last"]["warm"].update(started=1, completed=1)
    inner_budget["last"]["warm"]["stats"]["stage"] = "validation"
    warm_success = copy.deepcopy(rejected)
    warm_success["local_accepted"] = True
    warm_quality = dict(good, objective=-1)
    accepted_warm = copy.deepcopy(wm)
    accepted_warm.update(started=1, completed=1, status="accepted", raw_quality=warm_quality, after_quality=warm_quality)
    ws = accepted_warm["stats"]
    for role in CALLS:
        count = 2 if role in ("solve_n", "solve_t") else 1
        ws[role].update(started=count, completed=count, rc=0)
    checked = dict.fromkeys(CHECK_NUMBERS, 0)
    checked.update(valid=True, primal_feasible=True, basis_dual_feasible=True)
    ws.update(steps_started=1, steps_completed=1, pivots=1, rebuild_started=2, rebuild_completed=2,
        pricing_passes=2, work_items=1, verification_started=1, verification_completed=1, last_entering=0,
        last_leaving=1, last_theta=1, last_pivot=1, initial_checks=checked, last_checks=checked, stage="finished")
    ws["projection"]["enabled"] = True
    warm_success["last"].update(status="accepted", warm=accepted_warm, after_quality=warm_quality)
    final_budget = copy.deepcopy(warm_success)
    final_budget["local_accepted"] = False
    final_budget["last"]["status"] = "time_limit"
    update_partial = copy.deepcopy(inner_budget)
    partial_stats = copy.deepcopy(ws)
    partial_stats.update(steps_completed=0, pivots=0, rebuild_started=1, rebuild_completed=1,
        pricing_passes=1, verification_started=0, verification_completed=0, stage="update", projection=copy.deepcopy(projection))
    for role in ("solve_n", "solve_t"):
        partial_stats[role].update(started=1, completed=1)
    update_partial["last"]["warm"]["stats"] = partial_stats
    native_partial = copy.deepcopy(native_success)
    native_partial.update(completed=0, local_accepted=False)
    native_partial["last"].update(status="exception", crossover_status="exception", unprojected_quality=None,
        crossover_quality=None, after_quality=None, stats=native_stats,
        basis_export=dict(enabled=False, statuses_requested=False, statuses_received=False, published=False, columns=0, rows=0))
    native_budget = copy.deepcopy(native_success)
    native_budget["local_accepted"] = False
    native_budget["last"]["status"] = "time_limit"
    valid = (native_success, outer_entry, inner_budget, warm_success, final_budget, update_partial, native_partial, native_budget)
    for value in valid:
        B.require(valid_crossover(value), "新的真实阶段partial或成功合同不应误拒")
    invalid = []
    for role in ("init", "factor"):
        value = copy.deepcopy(warm_success); value["last"]["warm"]["stats"][role]["rc"] = 1; invalid.append(value)
    for key, wrong in (("adopted", 0), ("local_accepted", 1), ("oracle_decision", "bogus")):
        value = copy.deepcopy(warm_success); value[key] = wrong; invalid.append(value)
    value = copy.deepcopy(warm_success); value["last"]["basis_export"]["published"] = False; invalid.append(value)
    value = copy.deepcopy(warm_success); value["last"]["after_quality"] = value["last"]["crossover_quality"]; invalid.append(value)
    value = copy.deepcopy(warm_success); value["last"]["warm"]["stats"]["steps_completed"] = 0; invalid.append(value)
    for value in invalid:
        B.require(not valid_crossover(value), "错误库rc、类型或最终阶段选择必须拒绝")
    return dict(passed=True, public_lp_runs=0, inherited=inherited, stage_valid_cases=len(valid), stage_invalid_cases=len(invalid))


P.NEW_VERSION = NEW_VERSION
P.contract, P.valid_crossover = contract, valid_crossover
P.provenance, P.self_check = provenance, self_check

if __name__ == "__main__":
    P.main()

"""混合HSD/IPX域投影评测薄包装；复用冻结调度、质量、门槛和只读归档。"""
import argparse
import contextlib
import copy
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
from types import SimpleNamespace

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
import benchmark_experimental as C

B = C.build_tool
ENVIRONMENT, MARKER = "SOLVER_V117_CROSSOVER", "V117_CROSSOVER "
OLD_VERSION, NEW_VERSION = "ipm-cpu-0.53.0", "ipm-ipx-crossover-cpu-0.2.0"
ORIGINAL_PROTOCOL, ORIGINAL_SUMMARY = C.protocol, C.performance_summary
TOP_FIELDS = "schema enabled attempted started completed local_accepted adopted oracle_decision norms_ready norm_items bounds_inf cost_inf gate_seconds norm_seconds gate_checks last_gate_iteration last_gate_measures last".split()
LAST_FIELDS = "iteration bounds_inf cost_inf primal_ratio dual_ratio relative_gap deadline_saturated status before_quality unprojected_quality after_quality stats".split()
QUALITY_BOOLS = "primal_valid primal_feasible objective_consistent dual_valid dual_feasible gap_satisfied numerically_optimal".split()
QUALITY_NUMBERS = "objective max_row_violation max_bound_violation max_dual_residual objective_gap relative_objective_gap".split()
STAT_COUNTS = "load_started load_completed crossover_started crossover_completed get_started get_completed callback_checks callback_interrupts verification_started verification_completed".split()
STAT_TIMES = "prepare_seconds load_seconds crossover_seconds get_seconds native_scope_seconds verification_seconds total_seconds".split()
PREP_COUNTS = "duplicates_merged rounded_aggregates removed_free_rows free_row_duals_zeroed primal_changes dual_changes".split()
PROJECTION_COUNTS = "scan_started scan_completed scan_items eligible_rows project_started project_completed changed_rows".split()
RESIDUAL_FIELDS = "primal dual bounds complementarity dual_sign".split()
INFO_INTS = "status status_ipm status_crossover errflag num_var num_constr num_entries num_rows_solver num_cols_solver num_entries_solver dualized dense_cols centring_tried centring_success dependent_rows dependent_cols rows_inconsistent cols_inconsistent primal_dropped dual_dropped iter kktiter1 kktiter2 basis_repairs updates_start updates_ipm updates_crossover maxvol_updates maxvol_skipped maxvol_passes tbl_nnz".split()
INFO_NUMBERS = "abs_presidual abs_dresidual rel_presidual rel_dresidual pobjval dobjval rel_objgap complementarity normx normy normz objval primal_infeas dual_infeas time_total time_ipm1 time_ipm2 time_starting_basis time_crossover time_kkt_factorize time_kkt_solve time_maxvol time_cr1 time_cr1_AAt time_cr1_pre time_cr2 time_cr2_NNt time_cr2_B time_cr2_Bt ftran_sparse btran_sparse time_ftran time_btran time_lu_invert time_lu_update mean_fill max_fill time_symb_invert tbl_max frobnorm_squared lambdamax volume_increase".split()
STATUSES = "accepted rejected invalid_input numerical_error time_limit native_error unsupported_empty unsupported_integer unsupported_threads exception".split()


def contract(plan):
    value = plan["hybrid_protocol"]
    B.require(set(value) == {"validator_file", "validator_sha256", "environment", "marker", "schema",
        "on_backend_version", "off_backend_version", "marker_on_only"}, "混合协议字段不符")
    B.require(plan["candidate_version"] == 118 and plan["new_algorithm_round"] is True and
        plan["production_changes"] is False and plan["candidate_backend_version"] == NEW_VERSION and
        value["environment"] == ENVIRONMENT and value["marker"] == MARKER and
        type(value["schema"]) is int and value["schema"] == 2 and value["marker_on_only"] is True and
        value["on_backend_version"] == NEW_VERSION and value["off_backend_version"] == OLD_VERSION,
        "只允许测前冻结的混合版本与独立开关")
    path = (ROOT / value["validator_file"]).resolve()
    B.require(path == Path(__file__).resolve() and B.sha(path) == value["validator_sha256"], "混合验证器源码身份变化")
    if "tool_sources" in plan:
        B.verify({str(ROOT / name): digest for name, digest in plan["tool_sources"].items()})
    return value


def fields(value, keys):
    return type(value) is dict and set(value) == set(keys)


def integer(value, maximum=(1 << 64) - 1):
    return type(value) is int and 0 <= value <= maximum


def number(value, nonnegative=False, nullable=False):
    return value is None if nullable and value is None else type(value) in (int, float) and \
        -float("inf") < value < float("inf") and (not nonnegative or value >= 0)


def quality(value):
    return fields(value, QUALITY_BOOLS + QUALITY_NUMBERS) and all(type(value[key]) is bool for key in QUALITY_BOOLS) and \
        all(number(value[key], key.startswith("max_"), True) for key in QUALITY_NUMBERS)


def complete_quality(value):
    return value is not None and all(value[key] for key in ("primal_valid", "primal_feasible", "objective_consistent",
        "dual_valid", "numerically_optimal")) and value["objective"] is not None


def valid_projection(value):
    if not fields(value, PROJECTION_COUNTS + ["enabled", "project_rc", "max_abs_change", "seconds"]) or \
        type(value["enabled"]) is not bool or not all(integer(value[key]) for key in PROJECTION_COUNTS) or \
        not number(value["max_abs_change"], True) or not number(value["seconds"], True) or \
        value["project_rc"] is not None and type(value["project_rc"]) is not bool:
        return False
    if not 0 <= value["scan_completed"] <= value["scan_started"] <= 1 or \
        not 0 <= value["project_completed"] <= value["project_started"] <= value["scan_completed"] or \
        value["eligible_rows"] > value["scan_items"] or value["changed_rows"] > value["eligible_rows"] or \
        (value["project_rc"] is None) != (value["project_completed"] == 0) or \
        (value["changed_rows"] == 0) != (value["max_abs_change"] == 0):
        return False
    if not value["enabled"]:
        return all(value[key] == 0 for key in PROJECTION_COUNTS + ["max_abs_change", "seconds"]) and value["project_rc"] is None
    if value["scan_started"] == 0 and (value["scan_items"] or value["eligible_rows"]):
        return False
    return (value["project_started"] == 0 or value["eligible_rows"] > 0) and \
        (value["changed_rows"] == 0 or value["project_completed"] == 1 and value["project_rc"] is True)


def valid_stats(value):
    keys = STAT_COUNTS + STAT_TIMES + ["load_rc", "crossover_rc", "get_rc", "native_threads", "native_time_limit", "preparation", "native_info", "projection"]
    if not fields(value, keys) or not all(integer(value[key]) for key in STAT_COUNTS + ["native_threads"]) or \
        not all(number(value[key], True) for key in STAT_TIMES + ["native_time_limit"]):
        return False
    if value["callback_interrupts"] > value["callback_checks"] or value["native_time_limit"] > 5:
        return False
    if not 0 <= value["verification_completed"] <= value["verification_started"] <= 2 or \
        value["verification_started"] - value["verification_completed"] > 1 or not valid_projection(value["projection"]):
        return False
    for role in ("load", "crossover", "get"):
        started, completed, rc = (value[role + suffix] for suffix in ("_started", "_completed", "_rc"))
        if not 0 <= completed <= started <= 1 or (rc is None) != (completed == 0) or \
            rc is not None and (type(rc) is not int or not -(1 << 31) <= rc < (1 << 31)):
            return False
    if value["crossover_started"] > value["load_completed"] or value["get_started"] > value["crossover_completed"] or \
        value["crossover_started"] and value["load_rc"] != 0 or value["get_started"] and value["crossover_rc"] != 0 or \
        value["load_started"] and (value["native_threads"] != 1 or value["native_time_limit"] <= 0):
        return False
    if value["verification_started"] and (value["get_completed"] != 1 or value["get_rc"] != 0):
        return False
    prep = value["preparation"]
    if not fields(prep, PREP_COUNTS + ["max_aggregation_rounding", "raw", "dropped"]) or \
        not all(integer(prep[key]) for key in PREP_COUNTS) or not number(prep["max_aggregation_rounding"], True, True) or \
        any(not fields(prep[key], RESIDUAL_FIELDS) or not all(number(item, True, True) for item in prep[key].values()) for key in ("raw", "dropped")):
        return False
    info = value["native_info"]
    if info is not None and (not fields(info, INFO_INTS + INFO_NUMBERS) or
        not all(type(info[key]) is int and -(1 << 31) <= info[key] < (1 << 31) for key in INFO_INTS) or
        not all(number(info[key], key.startswith("time_"), True) for key in INFO_NUMBERS) or
        any(info[key] != 0 for key in ("status_ipm", "iter", "kktiter1", "kktiter2", "updates_ipm"))):
        return False
    return (value["load_completed"] == 0 or info is not None) and (value["get_started"] == 0 or info["status_crossover"] in (1, 2))


def valid_crossover(value):
    if not fields(value, TOP_FIELDS) or type(value["schema"]) is not int or value["schema"] != 2 or value["enabled"] is not True or \
        not all(type(value[key]) is bool for key in ("attempted", "local_accepted", "adopted", "norms_ready")) or \
        not all(integer(value[key]) for key in ("started", "completed", "norm_items", "gate_checks")) or \
        not all(number(value[key], True) for key in ("bounds_inf", "cost_inf", "gate_seconds", "norm_seconds")) or \
        value["oracle_decision"] not in ("not_consulted", "not_active", "accept", "reject", "budget", "error"):
        return False
    if not 0 <= value["completed"] <= value["started"] <= 1 or value["attempted"] != (value["started"] == 1):
        return False
    iteration, measures = value["last_gate_iteration"], value["last_gate_measures"]
    if (iteration is None) != (value["gate_checks"] == 0) or iteration is not None and (not integer(iteration) or iteration < 1) or \
        measures is not None and (type(measures) is not list or len(measures) != 3 or not all(number(item, True) for item in measures)):
        return False
    if value["gate_checks"] == 0 and (measures is not None or value["norms_ready"] or value["norm_items"] != 0 or
        value["gate_seconds"] != 0 or value["norm_seconds"] != 0):
        return False
    if not value["norms_ready"] and (value["bounds_inf"] != 0 or value["cost_inf"] != 0) or \
        value["local_accepted"] and not value["completed"] or value["adopted"] and (not value["local_accepted"] or value["oracle_decision"] not in ("accept", "not_active")) or \
        value["oracle_decision"] != "not_consulted" and not value["local_accepted"]:
        return False
    last = value["last"]
    if not value["started"]:
        return last is None and not value["local_accepted"] and not value["adopted"] and value["oracle_decision"] == "not_consulted"
    if not fields(last, LAST_FIELDS) or not value["norms_ready"] or iteration != last["iteration"] or \
        measures is None or not integer(last["iteration"]) or last["iteration"] < 1 or \
        not all(number(last[key], True) for key in ("bounds_inf", "cost_inf", "primal_ratio", "dual_ratio", "relative_gap")) or \
        any(last[key] > 1e-4 for key in ("primal_ratio", "dual_ratio", "relative_gap")) or \
        measures != [last[key] for key in ("primal_ratio", "dual_ratio", "relative_gap")] or \
        any(last[key] != value[key] for key in ("bounds_inf", "cost_inf")) or type(last["deadline_saturated"]) is not bool or \
        last["status"] not in STATUSES or not quality(last["before_quality"]) or \
        last["unprojected_quality"] is not None and not quality(last["unprojected_quality"]) or \
        last["after_quality"] is not None and not quality(last["after_quality"]) or not valid_stats(last["stats"]):
        return False
    before, after, stats = last["before_quality"], last["after_quality"], last["stats"]
    raw, projection = last["unprojected_quality"], stats["projection"]
    verify_started, verify_completed = stats["verification_started"], stats["verification_completed"]
    if not all(before[key] for key in ("primal_valid", "objective_consistent", "dual_valid", "dual_feasible")) or \
        before["objective"] is None or before["relative_objective_gap"] is None or before["numerically_optimal"] or \
        any(before[key] is None for key in ("max_row_violation", "max_bound_violation", "max_dual_residual")) or \
        value["local_accepted"] != (value["completed"] == 1 and last["status"] == "accepted"):
        return False
    if value["completed"] == 0:
        return last["status"] == "exception" and raw is None and after is None and value["oracle_decision"] == "not_consulted"
    if not projection["enabled"] or (raw is None) != (verify_completed == 0) or (after is None) != (verify_completed == 0) or \
        verify_completed < 2 and not B.equal(raw, after):
        return False
    if projection["scan_started"] and (verify_completed < 1 or complete_quality(raw)):
        return False
    if verify_started == 2 and (projection["project_completed"] != 1 or projection["project_rc"] is not True or
        projection["changed_rows"] == 0 or complete_quality(raw)):
        return False
    if verify_completed == 2 and projection["changed_rows"] != projection["eligible_rows"]:
        return False
    if verify_completed == 2 and any(not B.equal(raw[key], after[key]) for key in
        ("primal_valid", "primal_feasible", "objective_consistent", "objective", "max_row_violation", "max_bound_violation")):
        return False
    if value["local_accepted"] and (verify_started != verify_completed or verify_completed not in (1, 2) or
        verify_completed == 1 and not complete_quality(raw)):
        return False
    return not value["local_accepted"] or after is not None and all(after[key] for key in QUALITY_BOOLS) and after["objective"] is not None and \
        all(stats[role + "_completed"] == 1 and stats[role + "_rc"] == 0 for role in ("load", "crossover", "get"))


def inspect_crossover(stderr, enabled):
    lines = [line for line in stderr.splitlines() if line.startswith(MARKER)]
    if not enabled:
        return None, "unexpected_marker" if lines else None
    if len(lines) != 1:
        return None, "marker_count"
    try:
        value = B.parse(lines[0][len(MARKER):])
    except (TypeError, ValueError, RuntimeError):
        return None, "invalid_marker_json"
    return value, None if valid_crossover(value) else "invalid_marker_schema"


def common_protocol(plan):
    contract(plan)
    common = copy.deepcopy(plan)
    common["candidate_backend_version"] = OLD_VERSION
    return ORIGINAL_PROTOCOL(common)


def protocol(plan):
    runner, frozen = common_protocol(plan)
    old_config, old_valid, old_quality = runner.configuration_matches, runner.valid_process, runner.quality_fields
    old_environment, old_run_one = runner.solver_environment, runner.benchmark.run_one

    def configuration_matches(report, stage, variant, model, options):
        if not isinstance(report, dict):
            return False
        expected = NEW_VERSION if variant == "diagnostic_on" else "1.15.1" if variant == "highs" else OLD_VERSION
        if report.get("backend_version") != expected:
            return False
        probe = dict(report)
        if variant == "diagnostic_on":
            probe["backend_version"] = OLD_VERSION
        return old_config(probe, stage, variant, model, options)

    @contextlib.contextmanager
    def solver_environment(enabled):
        with old_environment(enabled):
            if enabled:
                os.environ[ENVIRONMENT] = "1"
            yield

    def run_one(*args, **kwargs):
        actual_environment = {ENVIRONMENT: os.environ[ENVIRONMENT]} if ENVIRONMENT in os.environ else {}
        row = old_run_one(*args, **kwargs)
        row["crossover_environment"] = actual_environment
        return row

    def valid_process(row):
        if not old_valid(row):
            return False
        enabled = row.get("requested_variant") == "diagnostic_on"
        if row.get("crossover_environment") != ({ENVIRONMENT: "1"} if enabled else {}):
            return False
        value, error = inspect_crossover(row["stderr"], enabled)
        return error is None and row.get("crossover_marker_error") is None and B.equal(row.get("crossover_marker"), value)

    def quality_fields(row, model, expected_solver, options):
        value, error = inspect_crossover(row["stderr"], row.get("requested_variant") == "diagnostic_on")
        probe = dict(row, crossover_marker=value, crossover_marker_error=error)
        return dict(old_quality(probe, model, expected_solver, options), crossover_marker=value, crossover_marker_error=error)

    runner.configuration_matches, runner.solver_environment = configuration_matches, solver_environment
    # 原benchmark模块由多层冻结运行器共享，只包装本次返回模块的视图。
    runner.benchmark = SimpleNamespace(**vars(runner.benchmark))
    runner.benchmark.run_one = run_one
    runner.valid_process, runner.quality_fields = valid_process, quality_fields
    return runner, frozen


def performance_summary(stage, rows, models, repeats, variants, runner, frozen, plan_sha, raw_sha):
    value = ORIGINAL_SUMMARY(stage, rows, models, repeats, variants, runner, frozen, plan_sha, raw_sha)
    value.update(crossover_marker_error_count=sum(row["crossover_marker_error"] is not None for row in rows),
        crossover_marker_runs=sum(row["crossover_marker"] is not None for row in rows))
    return value


def provenance(output, plan, create):
    target = output / "provenance" / "v118-benchmark.py"
    expected = plan["hybrid_protocol"]["validator_sha256"]
    if not target.exists() and create:
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with target.open("xb") as stream:
            stream.write(Path(__file__).read_bytes())
    B.require(target.is_file() and B.sha(target) == expected, "逐字评测包装快照缺失或变化")


def self_check(plan_path):
    current = C.protocol
    C.protocol = common_protocol
    try:
        inherited = C.self_check(plan_path)
    finally:
        C.protocol = current
    # 这里只构造序列化合同，不运行HSD、IPX或公开LP。
    empty = dict(schema=2, enabled=True, attempted=False, started=0, completed=0, local_accepted=False, adopted=False,
        oracle_decision="not_consulted", norms_ready=False, norm_items=0, bounds_inf=0, cost_inf=0, gate_seconds=0,
        norm_seconds=0, gate_checks=0, last_gate_iteration=None, last_gate_measures=None, last=None)
    prepared = dict.fromkeys(PREP_COUNTS, 0)
    prepared.update(max_aggregation_rounding=0, raw=dict.fromkeys(RESIDUAL_FIELDS, 0), dropped=dict.fromkeys(RESIDUAL_FIELDS, 0))
    stats = dict.fromkeys(STAT_COUNTS + STAT_TIMES + ["native_threads", "native_time_limit"], 0)
    projection = dict.fromkeys(PROJECTION_COUNTS + ["max_abs_change", "seconds"], 0)
    projection.update(enabled=False, project_rc=None)
    stats.update(load_rc=None, crossover_rc=None, get_rc=None, preparation=prepared, native_info=None, projection=projection)
    before = dict.fromkeys(QUALITY_BOOLS, False)
    before.update(dict.fromkeys(QUALITY_NUMBERS, 0))
    before.update(primal_valid=True, objective_consistent=True, dual_valid=True, dual_feasible=True)
    partial = dict(empty, attempted=True, started=1, norms_ready=True, norm_items=2, gate_checks=1,
        last_gate_iteration=1, last_gate_measures=[0, 0, 0], last=dict(iteration=1, bounds_inf=0, cost_inf=0,
        primal_ratio=0, dual_ratio=0, relative_gap=0, deadline_saturated=False, status="exception", before_quality=before,
        unprojected_quality=None, after_quality=None, stats=stats))
    returned = copy.deepcopy(partial)
    returned.update(completed=1, local_accepted=True)
    accepted_quality = dict(before, **dict.fromkeys(QUALITY_BOOLS, True))
    returned["last"].update(status="accepted", unprojected_quality=accepted_quality, after_quality=copy.deepcopy(accepted_quality))
    returned["last"]["stats"].update(native_threads=1, native_time_limit=4, verification_started=1, verification_completed=1,
        native_info=dict.fromkeys(INFO_INTS + INFO_NUMBERS, 0))
    returned["last"]["stats"]["projection"]["enabled"] = True
    returned["last"]["stats"]["native_info"].update(status_crossover=1, basis_repairs=-1)
    for role in ("load", "crossover", "get"):
        returned["last"]["stats"].update({role + "_started": 1, role + "_completed": 1, role + "_rc": 0})
    projected = copy.deepcopy(returned)
    rejected_quality = dict(accepted_quality, dual_feasible=False, numerically_optimal=False)
    projected["last"]["unprojected_quality"] = rejected_quality
    projected["last"]["stats"].update(verification_started=2, verification_completed=2)
    projected["last"]["stats"]["projection"].update(scan_started=1, scan_completed=1, scan_items=2, eligible_rows=2,
        project_started=1, project_completed=1, project_rc=True, changed_rows=2, max_abs_change=1e-12)
    second_partial = copy.deepcopy(projected)
    second_partial.update(local_accepted=False)
    second_partial["last"].update(status="time_limit", after_quality=copy.deepcopy(rejected_quality))
    second_partial["last"]["stats"]["verification_completed"] = 1
    comparison_partial = copy.deepcopy(second_partial)
    comparison_partial["last"]["stats"]["verification_started"] = 1
    comparison_partial["last"]["stats"]["projection"].update(changed_rows=0, max_abs_change=0)
    final_budget = copy.deepcopy(projected)
    final_budget.update(local_accepted=False)
    final_budget["last"]["status"] = "time_limit"
    valid = (empty, partial, returned, projected, second_partial, comparison_partial, final_budget)
    for value in valid:
        B.require(inspect_crossover(MARKER + json.dumps(value), True)[1] is None, "真实允许的投影/验算partial与未采用返回必须合法")
    B.require(inspect_crossover("", True)[1] == "marker_count", "开启时漏标记必须拒绝")
    B.require(inspect_crossover(MARKER + "{}\n" + MARKER + "{}", True)[1] == "marker_count", "重复标记必须拒绝")
    B.require(inspect_crossover(MARKER + "{}", False)[1] == "unexpected_marker", "关闭侧不得出现新标记")
    B.require(inspect_crossover(MARKER + '{"schema":2,"schema":2}', True)[1] == "invalid_marker_json", "重复JSON键必须拒绝")
    invalid = [dict(empty, started=True), dict(partial, adopted=True), dict(empty, unexpected=0)]
    bad_native = copy.deepcopy(returned); bad_native["last"]["stats"]["native_info"]["iter"] = 1; invalid.append(bad_native)
    bad_projection = copy.deepcopy(projected); bad_projection["last"]["stats"]["projection"]["project_rc"] = 1; invalid.append(bad_projection)
    bad_raw = copy.deepcopy(returned); bad_raw["last"]["unprojected_quality"] = None; invalid.append(bad_raw)
    false_success = copy.deepcopy(second_partial); false_success.update(local_accepted=True); false_success["last"]["status"] = "accepted"; invalid.append(false_success)
    invalid.append(dict(empty, schema=1))
    bad_primal = copy.deepcopy(projected); bad_primal["last"]["after_quality"]["objective"] = 1; invalid.append(bad_primal)
    for value in invalid:
        B.require(inspect_crossover(MARKER + json.dumps(value), True)[1] == "invalid_marker_schema", "非法类型/提交/原生IPM工作必须拒绝")
    runner, frozen = protocol(B.read(plan_path))
    model = runner.specification("development", frozen)["models"][0]
    report = dict(input=model["input"], backend="ipm", backend_version=NEW_VERSION,
        options=runner.base.expected_options("development", "candidate", frozen))
    B.require(runner.configuration_matches(report, "development", "diagnostic_on", model, frozen) and
        not runner.configuration_matches(dict(report, backend_version=OLD_VERSION), "development", "diagnostic_on", model, frozen),
        "混合开启侧必须显式使用新版本身份")
    return dict(passed=True, public_lp_runs=0, inherited=inherited, crossover_valid_cases=len(valid), crossover_marker_cases=4,
        crossover_invalid_cases=len(invalid), configuration_cases=2)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--plan", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--work", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--stage", required=True, choices=(*C.PERFORMANCE_STAGES, "self-check", "compatibility", "gate"))
    parser.add_argument("--archive-only", action="store_true", help="只重解析原始记录，不启动新LP")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    plan_path = (ROOT / args.plan).resolve()
    B.require(plan_path.is_relative_to(ROOT), "正式计划必须位于工作区")
    plan = B.read(plan_path)
    plan_sha = B.sha(plan_path)
    contract(plan)
    C.protocol, C.performance_summary = protocol, performance_summary
    try:
        if args.stage == "self-check":
            B.require(not args.archive_only, "self-check本身不启动LP")
            result = self_check(plan_path)
        else:
            B.require(args.output is not None, "阶段需要--output证据目录")
            output = (ROOT / args.output).resolve()
            B.require(output.is_relative_to(ROOT), "证据目录必须位于工作区")
            read_only = args.archive_only or args.stage in ("compatibility", "gate")
            provenance(output, plan, not read_only)
            if args.stage in ("compatibility", "gate"):
                result = C.compatibility(output, plan_path) if args.stage == "compatibility" else C.gate(output, plan_path)
            elif args.archive_only:
                _, result, _ = C.archive(args.stage, output, plan_path)
            else:
                B.require(args.work is not None, "新LP必须指定--work独立构建目录")
                work = (ROOT / args.work).resolve()
                result = C.run_performance(work, output, args.stage, plan_path)
            provenance(output, plan, False)
        print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False))
        passed = result.get("passed", True) and result.get("crossover_marker_error_count", 0) == 0
        if "valid_process_count" in result:
            passed = passed and result["valid_process_count"] == result["run_count"]
    finally:
        B.require(B.sha(plan_path) == plan_sha, "执行期间正式计划身份变化")
        contract(plan)
        C.protocol, C.performance_summary = ORIGINAL_PROTOCOL, ORIGINAL_SUMMARY
    raise SystemExit(0 if passed else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
